meta.title: Refund Policy | BuyDummyFlights
meta.description: Draft refund policy for BuyDummyFlights: where to find refund terms, how to request a correction or a refund, and what to include.

lead: Refund terms are shown at checkout before you pay. This page explains how requests are handled.
body: This is a draft that has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer, and the final wording may change. The terms shown at checkout when you order are the ones that apply to your order.

You pay for a flight reservation document, not an airfare. See [pricing](/pricing) for the plans. Because the document is prepared for your trip, the refund terms are read together with the delivery of that document.
If a name, date or route on your itinerary is wrong, contact us with your order reference. A correction is often the fastest way to fix the problem. Do not edit the PDF yourself.

1. Open the [contact page](/contact).
2. Include your order reference and the email used for the order.
3. Explain briefly why you are asking.
We will reply by email with the outcome.

An embassy, consulate, airline or authority may decide not to accept a document. We do not control those decisions and cannot promise acceptance. The [terms of service](/terms) set this out. Whether a refund applies in that case depends on the terms shown at checkout.
If your itinerary does not arrive, check your spam folder and then contact us. We will resend it.
Read the [FAQ](/faq) for common questions, or [how it works](/how-it-works) for the order steps.
